  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Production Operations Officer",
  "description": "KPMG is a global network of independent professional services firm with deep expertise in the provision of audit, tax and advisory services to clients in various industries and sectors of the economy. The Firm is well represented in Nigeria and across the African continent, with the objective of providing exceptional and quality services to multinational, regional and local clients and to enhance the product offerings in certain previously under-serviced markets.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Production Operations Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Contract

Job Summary


	We are currently seeking Production Operations Officers to support maintenance planning, scheduling, resource coordination, work pack preparation, materials readiness, and execution support across production operations.
	The position works closely with Operations, Maintenance, Procurement, Contractors, and other stakeholders to deliver integrated maintenance plans and schedules.


Requirements
You&rsquo;re a strong candidate if you have:


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in&nbsp;Engineering, Operations/Maintenance Management, or a related field; with a minimum of Second-Class Lower (2.2) GPA.
	3&ndash;5 years of experience in maintenance planning, scheduling, production operations, maintenance execution support, or asset integrity environments.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and enterprise systems such as ERP, CMMS, or asset management platforms. Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools will be an advantage
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
	Relevant professional certifications (e.g., P6, APICS/ASCM, NEBOSH, Six Sigma) will be an advantage.
	Experience working in oil &amp; gas, energy, or large industrial environments is preferred.


You&rsquo;ll help our oil and gas clients succeed by:


	Developing and maintaining integrated maintenance plans and schedules to support safe and reliable operations.
	Preparing execution-ready work packs, including task lists, job steps, resource requirements, and execution sequences.
	Coordinating maintenance resources, contractors, and specialist support to ensure effective work execution
	Liaising with operations, maintenance, procurement, logistics, and contractor teams to support execution readiness and schedule delivery.
	Managing materials, spares, and equipment readiness to support scheduled maintenance activities
	Supporting field execution teams through schedule updates, work scope adjustments, and execution feedback activities.
	Supporting integration of operational risks, asset priorities, and schedule constraints into planning and execution activities
	Participating in planning reviews, Integrated Activity Planning (IAP) sessions, and backlog management meetings
	Supporting risk-based maintenance planning and providing execution support to optimise schedule performance and continuous improvement.

Production Operations Officer Job at KPMG




        
    

        
        KPMG is a global network of independent professional services firm with deep expertise in the provision of audit, tax and advisory services to clients in various industries and sectors of the economy. The Firm is well represented in Nigeria and across the African continent, with the objective of providing exceptional and quality services to multinational, regional and local clients and to enhance the product offerings in certain previously under-serviced markets.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Production Operations Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Contract

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are currently seeking Production Operations Officers to support maintenance planning, scheduling, resource coordination, work pack preparation, materials readiness, and execution support across production operations.
	The position works closely with Operations, Maintenance, Procurement, Contractors, and other stakeholders to deliver integrated maintenance plans and schedules.


Requirements
You’re a strong candidate if you have:


	Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Operations/Maintenance Management, or a related field; with a minimum of Second-Class Lower (2.2) GPA.
	3–5 years of experience in maintenance planning, scheduling, production operations, maintenance execution support, or asset integrity environments.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and enterprise systems such as ERP, CMMS, or asset management platforms. Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools will be an advantage
	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
	Relevant professional certifications (e.g., P6, APICS/ASCM, NEBOSH, Six Sigma) will be an advantage.
	Experience working in oil & gas, energy, or large industrial environments is preferred.


You’ll help our oil and gas clients succeed by:


	Developing and maintaining integrated maintenance plans and schedules to support safe and reliable operations.
	Preparing execution-ready work packs, including task lists, job steps, resource requirements, and execution sequences.
	Coordinating maintenance resources, contractors, and specialist support to ensure effective work execution
	Liaising with operations, maintenance, procurement, logistics, and contractor teams to support execution readiness and schedule delivery.
	Managing materials, spares, and equipment readiness to support scheduled maintenance activities
	Supporting field execution teams through schedule updates, work scope adjustments, and execution feedback activities.
	Supporting integration of operational risks, asset priorities, and schedule constraints into planning and execution activities
	Participating in planning reviews, Integrated Activity Planning (IAP) sessions, and backlog management meetings
	Supporting risk-based maintenance planning and providing execution support to optimise schedule performance and continuous improvement.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Communications Manager",
  "description": "Amo Farm Sieberer Hatchery Limited has a Vision to be the market leader in the Day Old Chicks market; through exceptional quality products and services that will guarantee profitable poultry farming.

The Company produces high-quality Day-Old Chicks and Point of Cage Pullets. Over the years, we have remained focused on our main objective to produce high quality chicks, in a highly hygienic environment leveraging innovative solutions grounded in Research and Development.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Communications Manager

Job Location: Magodo Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

&nbsp;Job Summary&nbsp;


	Amo Farm Sieberer Hatchery Limited is seeking a strategic, creative and results-driven Communications Manager to lead the development and execution of the Company&#39;s internal and external communications strategy.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for strengthening the Company&#39;s corporate identity, managing communication across key stakeholder groups, developing compelling content and ensuring consistent, timely and professional communication across all channels.


The Role


	The Communications Manager will serve as a key custodian of the Company&#39;s voice, reputation and corporate messaging.
	The role will work closely with Management, HR, Commercial, Operations and other business functions to translate business priorities into clear and impactful communication while ensuring that all communications align with the Company&#39;s values, brand standards and strategic objectives.
	The successful candidate must combine strong strategic communication skills with excellent writing, storytelling, digital communication and stakeholder management capabilities.


Key Responsibilities
Communications Strategy &amp; Planning:


	Develop and implement an integrated communications strategy aligned with the Company&#39;s business objectives.
	Develop annual and quarterly communication plans covering internal, external, digital and corporate communications.
	Establish communication standards, guidelines and protocols across the organisation.
	Identify communication opportunities that support business growth, employee engagement and corporate reputation.
	Monitor communication effectiveness and recommend improvements based on audience feedback and performance data.


Internal Communications:


	Lead the development of effective internal communication programmes across the organisation.
	Develop and manage internal communication channels, including email communications, newsletters, employee announcements, town halls, campaigns and other employee engagement platforms.
	Translate complex business information into clear, engaging and accessible messages for employees.
	Partner with HR to support employee engagement initiatives, organisational change, culture-building programmes and employer branding.
	Develop communication materials for Management meetings, employee forums, leadership engagements and corporate events.
	Ensure employees receive timely and accurate information on key organisational developments, policies, initiatives and business milestones.


External &amp; Corporate Communications:


	Develop and manage external communications that strengthen the Company&#39;s corporate reputation.
	Prepare corporate announcements, press releases, speeches, corporate statements, articles, presentations and other communication materials.
	Manage communication with external stakeholders, including customers, partners, industry stakeholders, community groups and other relevant audiences.
	Support Management in communicating key corporate initiatives, achievements and strategic milestones.
	Develop corporate profiles, company presentations, fact sheets and other institutional communication materials.
	Coordinate external communication activities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.


Media &amp; Public Relations:


	Develop and maintain professional relationships with relevant media organisations and journalists.
	Coordinate media engagements, interviews, press briefings and corporate publicity opportunities.
	Prepare media statements, briefing notes, talking points and responses for Management.
	Monitor media coverage relating to the Company, its brands and relevant industry issues.
	Track public perception and identify potential reputational risks.
	Coordinate appropriate responses to media enquiries and emerging reputational issues.


Digital &amp; Social Media Communications:


	Develop and execute digital communication strategies across relevant platforms.
	Oversee the Company&#39;s social media presence and digital content calendar.
	Create and manage engaging content, including articles, graphics, videos, campaigns and other multimedia materials.
	Ensure consistency of corporate messaging and brand identity across digital platforms.
	Monitor digital engagement, audience growth, reach and content performance.
	Use analytics and insights to improve digital communication strategies.
	Work with creative agencies, designers, photographers, videographers and other external partners where required.
	Content Development &amp; Storytelling
	Develop compelling stories that communicate the Company&#39;s people, products, achievements, innovations and impact.
	Write and edit high-quality corporate content for different audiences and communication channels.
	Develop speeches, presentations, executive messages, newsletters, brochures, articles and campaign materials.
	Ensure all communication is accurate, clear, professional and aligned with the Company&#39;s tone of voice.
	Maintain a content library and communication calendar.


Brand &amp; Corporate Identity:


	Ensure consistency in the Company&#39;s corporate identity, messaging and visual communication.
	Work with relevant teams to ensure that communication materials comply with approved brand guidelines.
	Support the development and implementation of corporate branding initiatives.
	Review communication materials produced by internal teams and external agencies for consistency and quality.
	Support corporate events, exhibitions, conferences and other brand-building activities.


Crisis &amp; Reputation Management:


	Support the development and implementation of a corporate crisis communication framework.
	Monitor issues that may pose reputational or communication risks to the Company.
	Develop crisis communication materials, holding statements and stakeholder messaging when required.
	Coordinate communication responses during sensitive operational or reputational situations.
	Ensure communication during crises is timely, accurate, consistent and appropriately escalated.


Executive Communications:


	Support senior Management with strategic communication and executive visibility.
	Draft speeches, presentations, leadership messages, talking points and corporate statements.
	Prepare briefing materials for Management ahead of internal and external engagements.
	Help position Company leadership as credible voices within the agricultural, poultry and business sectors.


Events &amp; Corporate Engagement:


	Support the planning and execution of corporate events, conferences, stakeholder engagements and employee programmes.
	Develop event communication plans and promotional materials.
	Coordinate photography, videography, media coverage and post-event communication.
	Ensure key events and milestones are effectively communicated internally and externally.


Communication Measurement &amp; Reporting:


	Establish communication KPIs and monitor performance across communication channels.
	Analyse employee engagement, media coverage, digital performance and stakeholder feedback.
	Prepare periodic communications performance reports for Management.
	Use data and audience insights to improve communication effectiveness.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Mass Communication, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, English, Media Studies or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 5&ndash;8 years of relevant experience, with demonstrated experience in corporate communications, public relations, media, digital communications or a similar role.
	A Master&#39;s degree or professional certification in Communications, Public Relations, Corporate Communications or a related field will be an advantage.
	Proven experience developing and implementing communications strategies.
	Strong experience in corporate writing, content development and storytelling.
	Demonstrable experience managing digital and social media communications.
	Experience working with senior executives and managing sensitive corporate communications.
	Experience in media relations and reputation management is highly desirable.
	Experience in the agriculture, poultry, FMCG, manufacturing or other fast-moving business environment will be an advantage.


Key Competencies:


	Strategic Communications
	Corporate Communications
	Public Relations
	Media Relations
	Digital Communications
	Content Strategy &amp; Storytelling
	Executive Communications
	Brand Management
	Crisis Communications
	Stakeholder Management
	Copywriting &amp; Editing
	Social Media Management
	Event Communications
	Reputation Management
	Communication Analytics
	Project Management


The Ideal Candidate:


	The ideal candidate will be a strong communicator, strategic thinker and confident storyteller who can operate comfortably at both strategic and operational levels.
	You must be able to take a business objective, understand the audience and turn it into clear, compelling and purposeful communication.
	You should also possess the maturity and judgement required to handle confidential information, sensitive issues and high-level corporate communications with professionalism.


Method of Application&nbsp;
